_comment: Everything you can choose for the demo. build_demo.py reads this, passes
it to Vivado, and renders the RTL from it.
The eight HSCI pins match docs/hssio_for_demo.txt:
TX bank 69 byte0  -> clk fwd on BYTE0_PIN4/5, data on BYTE0_PIN10/11
RX bank 70 byte3  -> data on BYTE3_PIN2/3,    strobe on BYTE3_PIN6/7
The strobe is in the other nibble than the data; that's allowed because
C20 is a DBC pin and clocks both nibbles of its byte group.

hsci._force_rate_reason: speed grade -1 reaches 1250 Mb/s in native mode (DS925); the demo keeps 1600 as in hssio_for_demo.txt, which is fine for synthesis but not for silicon

clocking._comment: A differential system clock on a GC pin; the MMCM derives the XPLL reference and an independent AXI clock from it.

axi._comment: The JTAG-AXI deliberately runs on the MMCM AXI clock, not on hsci_pclk. axi_clock_converter crosses it to hsci_pclk for axi_hsci.
